s.t:
Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.
Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.
This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.
BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.
8+ years of full-time industry experience.
Hands-on experience with search technologies; proficiency in one or more search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch is required, with additional experience in vector databases being an advantage.
Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb .io press releases.
Who We Are
We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.
How We Work
We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

The LLM Observability (LLM O11y) team builds the foundational layer that makes AI workloads observable in Honeycomb .

We define how AI systems are represented in telemetry (spans, traces, token usage, cost, eval signals, etc), and ensure that data from diverse ecosystems (e.g., LangChain, OpenLLMetry, Braintrust) is normalized into a consistent OpenTelemetry-based model.

This team owns the infrastructure and data model that all downstream AI observability experiences rely on. Our work powers everything from cost analysis to anomaly detection. If you’re excited about defining and building the “source of truth” for how AI systems behave in production, this is the team for you.

Redzone is the #1 Connected Workforce Solution for manufacturers big and small. This role is fully remote.
Job Description
ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and utilized by the various business units within QAD | Redzone. This engineer joins the core platform team with three main areas of focus: building new capabilities into the platform, helping Applied AI teams at partner business units build and ship Champions correctly, and directly building Champion agents for business-unit use cases when needed.
You will work in the same codebase as the Applied AI engineers you support, which keeps the enablement work
practical and the platform work focused on real problems.

Platform Development
Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories
Improve developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.
Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that BU teams depend on.
Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment
Applied AI Enablement
Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly
Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup
Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation
Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout
Agent Development
Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged
Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents
Register agents in Champion Server and configure LaunchDarkly-gated prompt rollout across environments
Engineering Practices
We follow trunk-based development with PR-gated merges to main. Engineers are expected to:
Write tests before implementing. TDD is the expectation, not a nice-to-have.
Keep PRs small and focused; use feature flags to ship partial work incrementally
Follow conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, etc.)
Be mindful of API and schema backward-compatibility; prefer additive changes over breaking ones
Review your own diff before requesting review

Python: Proficient in async Python, Pydantic, type hints, and FastAPI. Experience with the Strands agent SDK or a comparable agentic framework. Testing is non-optional: candidates should be comfortable with pytest, pytest- asyncio, and DeepEval for agent-specific evaluation. We test agent behavior, not just unit logic.
Prompt Engineering: Able to write and iterate on production system prompts: XML-structured, scope-enforced, with tool descriptions that guide LLM delegation reliably.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Solid understanding of MCP and hands-on experience building or consuming MCP servers. Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is a strong plus.
Agent Patterns: Familiar with multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns beyond basic ReAct: supervisor/subagent delegation, parallel tool use, handoffs, and context management across agent boundaries.
Agent Evals: Able to design and run evaluation suites for agent behavior: correctness checks, scope enforcement tests, regression coverage, and systematic prompt iteration based on eval results.
Docker: Comfortable authoring Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and local dev environments via docker-compose / make.
PostgreSQL: Comfortable with templated INSERT/SELECT, foreign key relationships, and reading an ER diagram.
Git / Semantic Versioning: Follows conventional commit format (feat:, fix:) and a PR-based trunk workflow.

Kubernetes: Working knowledge of Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and ServiceAccounts. Able to read and adapt K8s manifests and use kubectl for basic troubleshooting.
AWS: Working knowledge of ECR, EKS, IAM, and Bedrock (inference layer).
OAuth2 / OIDC: Conceptual understanding of Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, token exchange, and agent auth delegation.
Terraform: Beginner-level familiarity; able to make targeted changes to existing modules and interpret a plan diff.
LaunchDarkly: Experience managing feature flags or AI config overrides for environment-gated rollout.
Document Intelligence / OCR: AWS Textract or comparable pipeline experience for use cases involving structured document extraction.
AI-Native Development
We run an AI-native SDLC. AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Cursor) are part of the standard engineering workflow at every stage: planning, implementation, review, and documentation. This is not optional or supplemental; it is how we work. Candidates should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and willing to invest in getting good at it.
Use Claude Code and Cursor actively across planning, implementation, and code review
Know when AI output is wrong and push back on it.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

As a Senior Software Engineer II on our Connected Devices team, you will set the technical direction for embedded software that powers Axon's next generation of public safety devices, including body-worn cameras, in-car cameras and the related devices. You will shape architecture decisions that directly impact mission-critical moments for law enforcement and first responders around the world.
You bring deep expertise in embedded systems and a strong ability to translate product and business goals into engineering strategy. You thrive at the intersection of technical leadership and mentorship, guiding engineers around you while driving the squad's roadmap and raising the quality bar across the team. Join a passionate, mission-driven group of engineers committed to making the world safer.

Location: This role is based out of our Ho Chi Minh Office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: Sr. Engineering Manager / Engineering Director
Own the technical direction for the squad, translating product goals into a clear engineering strategy and driving architectural decisions for embedded software systems.
Lead design and architecture reviews for major components, features, and systems, holding a high bar on stability, performance, and safety-critical quality.
Write well-tested, maintainable code and lead technical design and code reviews that elevate standards across the team.
Mentor and coach middle and senior engineers, actively growing the next generation of technical leaders on the team.
Drive AI-assisted development practices within the squad, establishing quality gates, review protocols, and reusable workflows that make AI adoption practical and safe.
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Design, and cross-functional Engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions that delight customers.
Identify and integrate the latest open source technologies to advance product capabilities while maintaining reliability in a mission-critical environment.
Improve engineering processes, including long-term technical planning, sprint execution, and continuous operational readiness improvements.

Required Skills
10+ years experience of professional software development in C/C++, Go, Python and/or another systems programming language
Strong experience developing, debugging, and shipping embedded software on Linux-based or RTOS-based devices.
Demonstrated track record of building well-tested software, including unit, integration, and system-level testing.
5+ years mentoring junior team members and/or leading small teams
Understanding of Computer Science fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, run-time analysis, object-oriented design and code quality verification
Networking knowledge (such as TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, DHCP, tunneling to support a diverse array of network configurations) is a plus

Familiarity with Linux-based embedded environments and real-time constraints.
Experience working on consumer or professional hardware products with tight security, low latency and high stability requirements.
You follow the latest developments in embedded software and open source technologies, and can distinguish between promising new practices and passing trends.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools across the software development lifecycle, with a strong understanding of review, validation, and safety guardrails.

We are looking for a talented engineer to lead evaluation of startup acquisition opportunities in the AI, cloud and security space. You will be a key partner to Datadog’s C-level leadership and highly visible at the most senior levels of Datadog. The role is reporting into the Senior Director of Product Strategy and falls within the Product organization.
We are looking for an innovative and strategic thinker who is passionate about the latest tech being developed by startups in the cloud, AI and security space. The Developer Platform Team enables engineering teams to build, test, deploy, and operate software efficiently at scale. We build the shared engineering foundations that boost developer velocity, enhance reliability, and reduce operational friction across the organization.
As a Software Engineer II , you will deliver key platform improvements that make engineering journeys faster, more reliable, and easier to use. Your work will directly impact how services are built, tested, packaged, and released company-wide.
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving developer journey problems at the intersection of the codebase, build systems, CI infrastructure, and shared engineering tooling. You will independently own well-scoped platform initiatives, write production-quality code, and collaborate with teams across engineering to turn recurring friction into durable, automated platform capabilities.

Improve Developer Velocity: Build and enhance internal systems to accelerate local development workflows, reduce CI wait times, minimize flaky test failures, and streamline service onboarding.
Strengthen Shared Engineering Foundations: Contribute to the Scala, Bazel, CI, and shared platform ecosystems to maintain scalable build configurations, clear dependency management, and reusable code patterns across repositories.
Reduce Engineering Toil: Identify repetitive, manual processes and replace them with automated, self-service platform capabilities, debugging tools, and CI visibility.
Improve Reliability & Signal Quality: Enhance CI success rates, speed up failure diagnosis, and increase the resilience of shared engineering systems under scale.
Apply AI-Assisted Engineering Practices: Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows thoughtfully to automate migrations, streamline testing, and establish guardrails for AI-assisted development.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Security, and Quality Engineering to drive adoption of paved paths and improve overall developer experience.

Independent Execution: Ability to independently deliver moderate-complexity engineering projects with sound judgment and high execution quality.
Engineering Fundamentals: Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience working in production codebases.
Tooling & CI/CD Focus: Experience improving developer workflows, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, or internal engineering tools.
Problem Solving & Debugging: Proven capability to debug complex technical issues and deliver durable, long-term fixes.
Collaboration & Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills with a track record of collaborative problem-solving across engineering teams.

Experience with Scala or the JVM ecosystem .
Hands-on experience with Bazel , modern CI/CD infrastructure , Kubernetes , or GitOps workflows .
Curiosity and familiarity with applying AI-assisted development tools or automated agentic workflows to developer tooling.
Note: We prioritize strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the drive to create leverage for other engineers over familiarity with a specific stack.

The systems built by the Developer Platform Team directly shape how engineering work gets done across the entire company. The improvements you make will compound daily across hundreds of developers, services, builds, and deployments—allowing your peers to spend less time fighting tooling and more time delivering value to customers.

Auth0 Emerging Tech is the Engineering organization where we take care of the hottest technology out there: we ship fast, we don't break things. We are a dynamic and collaborative distributed and diverse team. We value ownership, learning and innovation.
This is an ideal role for an engineer who enjoys building for other engineers, working across stacks, and shaping the future of AI enablement in production systems. You'll collaborate across engineering, product, and security teams to drive meaningful improvements in developer tooling, agent authentication, orchestration frameworks, and real-world demos.

Design and Build Developer Tooling that helps developers secure and manage infrastructure like MCP servers
Build Demo Applications that showcase secure, identity-powered AI use cases in real-world environments
Contribute to Open Source Projects , both within Auth0 and across the broader AI + identity ecosystem

Drive Integration with Emerging AI Frameworks by creating adapters, utilities, and interfaces for agent runtimes and orchestration layers
Collaborate with Design, Product, and Security teams to align on developer needs, roadmap direction, and compliance requirements
Mentor and Support Other Engineers , setting strong examples in code quality, testing practices, and architectural thinking
Influence Engineering Standards by leading design discussions and contributing to team-wide architectural decisions
Ensure Resilience and Security of systems involved in agent-to-agent or model-to-service communication

Quantum Systems has scaled rapidly from 300 to over 1,700 people, and our engineering practices need to evolve with us. As part of the Software Factory team within our Core Domain, your mission is to accelerate developer velocity, eliminate friction, and upgrade system quality across the entire organization.
You won’t just maintain infrastructure; you will actively shape our engineering culture. You will design, build, and champion the state-of-the-art development tooling and CI infrastructure that powers our large, polyglot environment. From defining pragmatic engineering processes to tracking our success with metrics such as DORA, you will ensure our engineering teams can move faster and safer.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Drive Technical & Process Evolution: Mentor and guide software teams toward modern engineering practices (e.g., modern monorepos, automated testing, trunk-based development). You will gain authentic buy-in by demonstrating the "why" rather than forcing compliance.
Bridge the Gap: Meet teams where they are currently. By truly understanding their pain points and listening to resistance, you will build a roadmap to gently but firmly guide them toward efficiency.
Eliminate Friction: Identify opportunities to simplify processes and streamline workflows. Your ultimate goal is creating a faster, smoother Developer Experience (DevEx).
Cultivate a Growth Mindset: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and iterative learning (Kaizen). You will help the team turn operational mistakes into blameless learning opportunities.
Evolve the Build & CI Ecosystem: Continuously optimize our large-scale build and CI/CD environments. You will ensure fast, reliable, and reproducible feedback loops for developers.
Shape the Future Base OS: Collaborate with embedded and infrastructure teams on our transition toward a managed, image-based Base OS for high-performance compute targets.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
The Transformation Toolkit
Patience & Pragmatism: You understand that cultural shifts don't happen overnight, allowing you to celebrate small wins, build momentum, and remain non-dogmatic under pressure.
High EQ & Influence: An empathetic communicator with the exceptional skills required to address fears of change and motivate teams through inspiration rather than mandate.
Tech Credibility: A strong software engineering background that allows you to speak the team’s language, understand constraints, and earn their technical respect.
Technical Skills (Required)
Build System Expertise: Strong experience managing, scaling, or architecting build systems for large, polyglot codebases. You should be comfortable with advanced build orchestration.
CI/CD & DevTools Automation: Deep practical knowledge of building and operating robust CI/CD pipelines and developer enablement tools at scale.
Process & Velocity Focus: Experience defining and rolling out clean engineering standards (Definition of Done, linting) and a passion for measuring developer experience using data (like DORA metrics).
Linux Fundamentals: Solid grasp of Linux-based systems, networking, and deployment automation.

Bazel Expertise: Deep experience with Bazel is a massive plus and will give you a major head start.
Image-Based Provisioning: Experience with modern OS compilation, immutable infrastructure, or image-based provisioning for high-performance compute/embedded targets (e.g., Yocto, Nix/NixOS, systemd-mkosi, or Nvidia Jetpack).
Cloud & IaC Foundations: Familiarity with cloud-native systems and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to interface effectively with our dedicated cloud teams.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin, TX

The CNI team builds and operates the systems that let Cloudflare's enterprise customers connect their networks directly to Cloudflare through private, dedicated interconnects — rather than traversing the public Internet. The product, Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), supports various interconnect types across hundreds of locations worldwide. These systems underpin Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Zero Trust, and application security for some of Cloudflare's largest customers.

As a member of the team you will build and extend the systems that provision, monitor, and orchestrate private network interconnects at scale. You will collaborate with Product Management, Network Engineering, and Infrastructure teams on ambitious initiatives to connect enterprise customers directly to Cloudflare's global network.
You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle: from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Kubernetes, Linux networking, network operating systems, and BGP routing, among others.
Our team at Cloudflare operates under a "Run What You Build" model. This means we are responsible for the health of our systems and actively participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of our operational duties.
Because you'll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.

Systems-level programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++.
Understanding of IP networking fundamentals: BGP, Layer 3 routing, and how physical and virtual interconnect technologies work (cross-connects, VLANs, overlay tunnels).
Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed systems.
Experience participating in an on-call rotation for services with direct customer impact.
Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your workflow.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Hands-on experience with BGP configuration, route policy, or peering operations.
Experience building provisioning or automation systems for network infrastructure.
Familiarity with network inventory and IPAM systems (e.g., NetBox).
Experience with cloud provider networking (AWS Direct Connect, GCP Partner Interconnect, Azure ExpressRoute).
Knowledge of GRE, VXLAN, or other overlay/tunnel technologies.
Experience with Kubernetes-based service deployments and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with telemetry/observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch).
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
You'll work with HelloFresh's GenAI Enablement Squad , a cross-functional team helping teams across the company unlock the practical value of AI. The mission is simple: identify high-impact problems, build AI-powered solutions that solve them, and scale what works.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business.

One week you might be embedded with the HR or Finance teams understanding how they work; the next you'll be building an agentic workflow, integrating it into the internal tooling, or scaling a successful prototype into a production system used across the company.
This is a highly hands-on role. You'll work on problems from discovery to production, working directly with engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders. Rather than waiting for requirements, you'll help define them—identifying where AI can create real leverage and shipping solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
While you'll support and advise other engineers and influence technical direction, your primary impact comes from building products people actually use.

Partner directly with teams across HelloFresh to understand their workflows, uncover opportunities, and identify where AI can meaningfully improve productivity or decision-making.
Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions and validate them with real users before investing in production systems.
Design, build, and operate production-grade AI applications including agents, workflow automations, retrieval systems, developer tools, and business assistants.
Deliver projects end-to-end—from problem discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration.
Build reusable AI assistants distributed through the internal plugin marketplace, helping teams solve recurring problems without reinventing the wheel.
Turn successful one-off solutions into reusable platform capabilities that accelerate future AI development across the organisation.
Work closely with platform engineers to improve the internal AI infrastructure, ensuring solutions remain reliable, secure, observable, and cost-effective.
Share knowledge across the engineering organisation and support teammates through design discussions, pairing, and technical guidance.

Experience building production AI applications using modern LLMs, including agents, RAG, workflow automation, structured generation, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building reliable, maintainable, observable production systems.
A product mindset—you care as much about user adoption and business impact as technical elegance.
Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders to understand ambiguous problems and translate them into software.
Comfort moving quickly from idea to prototype while knowing when to invest in scalability and production quality.
Experience working with managed AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Vertex AI.
Strong programming skills in Python or another modern backend language.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical audiences.
Curiosity, pragmatism, and a willingness to experiment. You know there is rarely a perfect AI solution—only one that delivers meaningful value.

Experience building internal developer platforms or productivity tooling.
Experience evaluating LLM quality, latency, and cost trade-offs.
Experience deploying AI systems at organisational scale.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, agent orchestration frameworks, or workflow engines.
Experience measuring AI adoption and defining product success metrics.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

About Proton
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default
Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!
We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !

Based in our Geneva (or Zürich) office, you'll join our browser product team, helping build a privacy-first internet browser used by millions around the world. From private-by-default browsing to shipping timely security updates, you'll work on a technically ambitious product with real-world impact.

As an engineer on the team, you'll collaborate closely with product, design, and more experienced engineers across Proton to build and ship a high-quality browsing experience on desktop, growing your craft while contributing to what "great" looks like for privacy-focused consumer products at scale.

You have hands-on experience building or maintaining a Chromium-based browser, or contributing to browser engineering at scale
You are proficient in C++ and comfortable navigating large codebases such as Chromium's (Blink, V8, network stack, sandboxing, extensions)
You have familiarity with Chromium's build system and cross-platform builds (macOS, Windows, Linux)
You have implemented privacy or security hardening in practice — anti-fingerprinting measures, content blocking, or reducing telemetry and third-party dependencies
You care deeply about product quality, performance, and delivering a fast, distraction-free user experience
You have solid knowledge of web platform standards and the security responsibilities of shipping a browser
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity in a small, high-ownership team, and experience working in open source is a strong plus
Rust experience is a plus as we explore platform-independent components

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here )

Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with other teams (Graphics, Physics, Avatar) to ensure cohesive integration of geometry components into the broader Roblox experience.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Tax compliance is a hard problem. When millions of payments flow through a marketplace or platform, the rules for what gets reported, to whom, in which format, and by when are complex, high-stakes, and vary by country.

The Connect Tax Reporting team builds products to help businesses collect and verify tax information, prepare and deliver tax forms, and manage reporting obligations across jurisdictions. This includes 1099 reporting in the US and digital platform reporting across the EU, Australia, Canada, the UK, and other regions.
This is a domain where correctness, reliability, and user trust matter deeply. A late filing, an incorrect form, or a missed reporting threshold can create regulatory risk and erode trust with platforms and their sellers. Our systems handle high-volume seasonal workflows, support complex country-specific rules, and remain dependable under fixed filing deadlines.

You’ll build products and systems that simplify tax reporting for platforms and their users. You’ll take projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operation.
Your work may include improving tax information collection, building APIs and data pipelines, automating reporting processes, and strengthening the reliability of production systems. You’ll collaborate with product managers, tax operations, support, and engineers across Stripe. AI-assisted development will be part of your day-to-day work as you design, build, test, and operate software.

Design, build, and operate features across tax reporting user experiences, APIs, services, and data workflows

Improve tax reporting workflows through automation and operational tooling
Review code and collaborate with engineers to improve implementation quality and share technical context
Monitor production systems, respond to incidents, and improve reliability, observability, and runbooks
Partner with product, tax operations, support, and engineering teams to deliver solutions that meet user needs

Bei Conceptboard bauen wir ein Kollaborationsprodukt, auf das Enterprise-Kunden, öffentliche Institutionen und sicherheitskritische Organisationen täglich vertrauen. Damit die Teams, die dieses Produkt entwickeln, jederzeit auf voller Geschwindigkeit liefern können, brauchen sie eine Plattform, die ihnen aus dem Weg geht – nicht eine, die sie ausbremst.
Als Platform Architect / Staff Engineer bist du Eigentümer der Core Platform Architecture – und du baust sie selbst, hands-on. Dein Design-Constraint Nummer eins: Die Plattform ist nie der Bottleneck. Du denkst in Self-Service-Capabilities, sauberen Contracts und klaren Boundaries – und du machst das Platform-Team zum Agentic-Engineering-Lighthouse der gesamten Organisation. Das hier ist keine Ivory-Tower-Rolle: Du setzt Richtung, indem du sie shippst.
Your Responsibilities Target Architecture ownen. Du formulierst, validierst und entwickelst die Architecture der Core Platform – inklusive der make-or-break Entscheidungen dahinter. Du bist die primäre Ansprechperson für Architektur-Ownership auf Platform-Ebene und entlastest damit die bestehende Architektur-Verantwortung von einer einzelnen Person.
Hands-on bauen. Du leitest und trägst persönlich zum Proof-of-Concept bei, der die kritischen Hypothesen validiert – und danach zu den Platform Services selbst. Du bist Builder, nicht nur Designer.
Platform as a Product. Du designst Services als Self-Service-Capabilities, die Module-Teams unblocked halten. Thinnest viable Platform beats Gold-Plating, immer.
Contracts & Standards setzen und schützen. Du definierst und sicherst die Contracts zwischen Plattform und Module-Teams: APIs, Boundaries, Non-Functional Requirements – und sorgst dafür, dass sie eingehalten werden.
Agentic-First von Tag eins. Du etablierst disziplinierte Agentic-Engineering-Practices im Platform-Team und machst es zur Referenz für die gesamte Engineering-Organisation.
Lead by Example. Du inspirierst dein Team mit einem Platform-First-Mindset. Deine Teammitglieder wachsen, weil sie dir zuschauen – und weil du die Standards, die du setzt, selbst lebst.
Alignment mit dem Architect. Du arbeitest eng mit dem bestehenden Architect zusammen, um übergreifende Architektur-Entscheidungen abzustimmen und zu validieren.
Dein Profil Must-haves
Hands-on Builder mit starkem Track Record. Du hast Plattformen oder Services at scale architektiert und gebaut – und du codest noch. Kein reiner Architecture-by-PowerPoint-Hintergrund.
Platform-as-a-Product-Instinct. Du hast Self-Service-Plattformen gebaut, die andere Teams schneller gemacht haben. Du weißt, wie Plattformen zum Bottleneck werden – und designst aktiv dagegen. Interne Teams sind für dich echte Kunden.
Sound Engineering Practices. Testing, Contracts, Observability, CI/CD, klare Boundaries – und das Urteilsvermögen, welche Non-Functional Requirements tatsächlich zählen.
Genuine Motivation für Agentic Engineering. Du willst Agentic-First mit Disziplin bauen, nicht mit Hype – und du willst es für andere modellieren.

Erfahrung in regulierten Umgebungen mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen.
Relevante Domain-Tiefe für eine Collaboration-Plattform, z. B. Distributed Systems oder Real-Time-Architektur.
Erfahrung mit Agentic-First-Workflows – privat oder professionell.
Das erwartet dich bei uns Flexibilität – Genieße umfassende Freiheit bezüglich deines Arbeitsortes und gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen.
Eigenverantwortung – Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten, unterstützt von einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Internationalität – wir arbeiten in einem globalen Team, das kulturelle Vielfalt schätzt und fördert. Unser internationales Netzwerk ermöglicht es dir, weltweit Kontakte zu knüpfen.

Worum es geht
Wir bauen myScribe – eine KI-gestützte Dokumentationslösung, die Ärztinnen und Ärzten den Rücken freihalten soll, damit sie sich wieder auf das konzentrieren können, wofür sie eigentlich Medizin studiert haben: Patientinnen und Patienten. Dazu kommt myScribe Connect, mit dem wir unsere Lösung tief in die Krankenhaus-IT integrieren.
Klingt nach Mission? Ist es auch. Aber wir sind kein Pitch-Deck – wir sind ein Produktteam, das jeden Tag echten Code in echte Kliniken bringt.
Wo wir gerade stehen
myScribe läuft heute dort, wo die Ärzt\*innen arbeiten: On-Prem, in der Klinik-IT, bei zahlenden Kunden in der DACH-Region. Trotzdem releasen wir mehrmals pro Woche – Continuous Deployment, Fix-Forward, ohne Wartungsfenster-Drama. Im Gesundheitswesen? Eher unüblich.
Doch der Markt verschiebt sich: KI-Inferenz wird teuer, Kunden öffnen sich für die Cloud, SaaS rückt in den Fokus. Um diesen Wandel – und alles, was noch kommt – aktiv mitzugestalten, bauen wir gerade das Core-Entwicklungsteam auf, das myScribe durch die nächsten Jahre trägt. Sei dabei.
Aufgaben
Du entwickelst end-to-end an unserem Produkt mit – von der API bis zur UI, vom Konzept bis ins Deployment. Du denkst in Features, nicht in Tickets. Du verstehst, warum eine Funktion gebaut wird, und entscheidest mit, wie sie am besten umgesetzt wird. Wenn etwas in Produktion bricht, willst du wissen, warum – und es dann richtig fixen.
Konkret arbeitest du an unserem .NET-Backend und unseren TypeScript-Frontends, baust und betreust Docker-Container und entwickelst unsere CI/CD-Pipeline weiter.
Du baust mit am SaaS-Stack, der gerade entsteht – Multi-Tenancy, Cloud-Deployment, Skalierung.
Und du arbeitest an den Integrationen, die uns einzigartig machen: FHIR, ISiK, KIS-Anbindungen.
Wie wir arbeiten
Wir sind AI-native. Agentische Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Cursor sind für uns kein Experiment, sondern Teil des täglichen Werkzeugkastens. Wir erwarten, dass du solche Tools bereits produktiv einsetzt und ihre Stärken und Grenzen aus eigener Erfahrung kennst.
Wir testen, reviewen und refactorn, weil das der einzige Weg ist, dauerhaft schnell zu bleiben. „Quick & Dirty" ist bei uns keine Tugend – aber Prozess um des Prozesses willen auch nicht. Eine Idee am Montag, ein erster Rollout später in der Woche ist normal, nicht die Ausnahme. Kein Scrum-Theater, aber klare Verantwortlichkeiten.
Qualifikation
Mindestens 5 Jahre professionelle Erfahrung als Fullstack-Entwickler:in mit .NET (C#) und TypeScript in Produktionsumgebungen (gerne mit React, Angular oder Vue – wir streiten uns nicht über Frameworks, sondern entscheiden pragmatisch)
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1 oder besser) – unsere Domäne ist das deutsche Gesundheitswesen, und du kommunizierst täglich mit deutschsprachigen Kunden und Kolleg:innen
DevOps-Kenntnisse: Docker ist Pflicht, Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure oder vergleichbarem ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit SaaS-Architekturen und Multi-Tenancy ist hochwillkommen
Erfahrung mit Cloud Development und Cloud-Infrastrukturen (z. B. AWS, perspektivisch auch andere Cloud-Plattformen) – insbesondere im Hinblick auf skalierbare und moderne SaaS-Architekturen ein klarer Pluspunkt
Souveräner Umgang mit agentischen Coding-Tools – du kennst ihre Stärken und Grenzen aus eigener Erfahrung
Ein echtes Qualitätsverständnis: Tests, Code Reviews, sauberes Refactoring sind für dich kein Overhead, sondern die Grundlage dafür, schnell liefern zu können
Ownership im besten Sinne: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das, was du baust – inklusive Betrieb und Monitoring
Lust auf agile Produktentwicklung in einem kleinen Team, das gerade Fahrt aufnimmt
Einen Healthcare-Background. Den lernst du bei uns. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich in eine komplexe Domäne reinzudenken – und dort wirklich Spuren zu hinterlassen.

Ein Produkt mit Sinn – wir machen Klinikalltag messbar besser
Echte Mitgestaltung an einem Produkt und einem Team, das gerade Form annimmt
Modernes Tooling und das Vertrauen, es eigenverantwortlich einzusetzen
Faires Gehalt und VSOP-Beteiligung
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Hybrid/Remote

This role requires strong backend development experience, problem-solving ability, ownership mindset, and the ability to independently deliver medium-to-large technical initiatives. Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.
We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.
GoldSim, a Datacor company, is a world leader in dynamic simulation software for water resources, environmental systems, and complex engineering problems.

Our customers use GoldSim to model some of the most challenging questions in engineering and science from managing critical water supplies to assessing the long-term safety of environmental systems. We are looking for a creative problem-solver to join our development team.

This is a mid-level to senior position where you will have a direct impact as we develop new modeling capabilities to enhance GoldSim, our state-of-the-art modeling and simulation framework.

What you’ll Do Numerical & Algorithmic Ownership Own the numerical solutions and mathematical/computer science algorithms underlying GoldSim's simulation engine - from the theoretical foundation (equations, algorithm design) through to implementation in our C++ codebase.

Push practical, real-world improvements to GoldSim's numerical capabilities, and propose new features driven by everyday or discipline-specific customer needs. Participate in design discussions across the full development lifecycle, not just the mathematical layer.

Model Building & Verification Build GoldSim models that apply and exercise the platform's numerical capabilities - for QA and verification, as example models shipped with the product, and in direct support of customers. Use hands-on model-building as a primary way to validate that new or improved algorithms behave correctly in practice.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer Document both the theoretical basis (equations, algorithm descriptions) and the practical implementation of GoldSim's numerical methods, so this knowledge isn't concentrated in one person. Partner with the founding engineer to formalize existing modeling, QA, and support methodology.

Collaboration & Support Work alongside the software engineering team to integrate new or improved numerical capabilities into the broader platform. Translate business and product requirements into technical specifications. Serve as a technical resource for customer support and QA on advanced modeling and numerical questions.

Communicate technical/mathematical concepts clearly to engineers, QA, and product stakeholders. Growth & Modernization
Bring curiosity for modern computational approaches - including applying machine learning to accelerate, approximate, or extend traditional numerical simulation methods.
Help identify opportunities to modernize GoldSim's existing algorithmic infrastructure.
Requirements Masters or PhD level in science or engineering, with outstanding academic performance. Broad experience with applied math and numerical methods for solving science and engineering problems (e.g., matrix algebra, numerical methods for solving partial differential equations).

Earth sciences or civil engineering background, preferably including contaminant transport modeling. Extensive C++ programming experience, ideally in scientific or engineering applications; familiarity with commercial or open-source numerical libraries and frameworks is a plus.

Proven ability to design and implement practical numerical solutions to real-world problems. Good communications skills, must write effectively and enjoy interacting with other team members. Experience developing and supporting Windows desktop applications is a plus, as is hands-on experience with data science tools such as MATLAB, R, or Tableau.

Experience applying AI/ML techniques (e.g., machine learning models, LLM-based tools, or AI-assisted development) to scientific or engineering software is a plus. Why GoldSim Join a team where your work directly shapes software that engineers and scientists rely on around the world.

You'll take on meaningful technical challenges, enjoy real autonomy, and help define the future of a product with a global reputation for excellence. We have offices across the US where you have the opportunity to come in as you would like including one in Seattle.
Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Summary: We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Full Stack Developer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems that operate at significant scale and across multiple business domains.

In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan.

The successful candidate will bring deep backend expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, component-driven front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks.

You will work closely with product managers, architects, DevOps engineers, and fellow developers in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, secure, and performant applications that directly support strategic business outcomes. Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and continuously refine scalable microservices using Java (11/17) and the Spring Boot framework, ensuring each service is independently deployable, observable, and aligned with the broader enterprise architecture roadmap.
Author secure, well-tested, and high-quality production code that adheres to internal coding standards, follows established design patterns, and incorporates defense-in-depth security principles such as input validation, authentication, and encryption at rest and in transit.
Develop responsive, component-based front-end applications using React (or equivalent frameworks such as Angular or Vue), with strong attention to user experience, accessibility, browser compatibility, and performance on both desktop and mobile devices.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations that connect distributed backend systems, defining clear contracts, versioning strategies, and error-handling semantics to ensure smooth interoperability between services.
Actively participate in architecture and design discussions, contributing thoughtful trade-off analyses around scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and cost-efficiency, and helping the team converge on solutions that meet both current and projected business needs.
Continuously profile and optimize application performance, database queries, JVM tuning parameters, and API throughput, identifying bottlenecks through systematic measurement and applying targeted improvements with quantifiable impact.
Implement and maintain robust state management patterns (Redux, Context API, NgRx, or equivalents) for complex front-end applications, ensuring predictable data flow, easier debugging, and clean separation of concerns between UI components and business logic.
Develop comprehensive automated test suites — unit, integration, contract, and functional — using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, and Cypress, treating tests as first-class deliverables that protect velocity and confidence over the long term.
Contribute meaningfully to CI/CD pipeline design and deployment automation using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, enabling fast, safe, and repeatable releases to multiple environments.
Proactively identify system bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses, and drive concrete remediation efforts through refactoring proposals, technical design documents, and well-scoped engineering initiatives.
Collaborate effectively within Agile/Scrum delivery teams, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives to ensure consistent delivery of high-value increments.
Maintain clear, current, and comprehensive technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, API specifications, deployment guides, and runbooks — so that knowledge is shareable and the system remains supportable as the team scales.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
Five or more years of professional software development experience building production-grade enterprise applications.
Strong, demonstrable understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and end-to-end system design principles.
Advanced working knowledge of Java (versions 11 and 17), the Spring Boot framework, and the design of clean, idiomatic RESTful APIs.

At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology.

Come be a part of what’s next. We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content.

Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. Our Team The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business.

This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution.

This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them. Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content.

As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time.

Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision. Skills & experience we’re seeking:
Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.
General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.
Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.
Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),
Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.
Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.
Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints
Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams: The Ad Supply team manages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model.

The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement team builds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers.

Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes. The Ads Identity and Audience team is dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy.

Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations.

We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy team at Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide. The Ads Media Planning team is at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix ’s advertising business.

We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix ’s platform.

Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale.

We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix ’s broader business goals. The Live Ads Management team is driving one of Netflix ’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events.

We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix ’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts.

We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience.

We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows.

Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management team is responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers.

The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting team builds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations.

The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization. The Ads Data Clean Room team is redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising.

We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly.

As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team ’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes.

The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams.

This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing team builds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations.

The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board.

This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows. The Ads Reporting Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders.

Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes.

They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results. The Ads CRM team delivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing.

We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness.

Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads. The Human Agent Tooling team builds the software Chime's support agents use every day to help members. When a member has a problem a bot can't solve, a human agent picks it up — and the tools we build are what let that agent understand the member's situation, take the right action, and resolve the issue quickly and safely. That includes the agent workspace, case management, the systems that surface member context in real time, and the controls that govern what actions agents can take.
Our mission is to make every human support interaction faster, safer, and more effective. When our tools work well, agents resolve issues in fewer clicks and members get better answers — and we measure our success by both.
We're investing heavily in this platform: modernizing the agent experience, building safer and more granular access controls, and improving how agent tooling connects to the rest of Chime's systems. We work closely with Product, Operations, and the agents themselves to shape what great support tooling looks like.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $117,000.00 and up to $162,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Agent workspace — Contribute to the tools agents use to view member context, manage cases, and take action. You'll build well-scoped features that make agents' day-to-day faster and less error-prone.
Member context and case data — Help build the systems that pull together the right information about a member and surface it to the agent at the right moment.
Access controls and safety — Work on the permissions and guardrails that determine what actions agents can take on member accounts. These systems handle sensitive moments and need to be correct and reliable.
Integrations — Build and maintain the connections between agent tooling and the other Chime systems agents depend on, with support from your team.
Observability — Add logging, monitoring, and dashboards so we can see how tools are performing and catch issues early.
To thrive in this role, you have
Some professional software development experience (roughly 1+ years) or equivalent through internships, projects, or a strong CS foundation
Exposure to Ruby on Rails or a comparable web framework, or eagerness to learn it
Familiarity with working against a database
An appreciation for maintainable, well-tested code
A strong desire to learn and to dig into how things actually work
Curiosity about the people who use what you build

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.
We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production — capacities, costs, constraints — and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.
Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on screen.

The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.
How we work
Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.
Feedback runs both ways and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.
We like this work, and you'll notice. The energy of a small team that cares is what people remember about being here. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.

You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.
This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer and with our research engineers on the optimization engine, and you build on eye level with the founders.
Shaping. You shape how this team works, not just what it builds. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
